title: Tenu Loriyan Devay Maa Ujri Aik Vaari Mur Kay Aa Asghar
body:
Meri Jholi Nu Haye Khali Ker Kay, Leya Mout Nay Jholi Paa Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa Phar Kay Laash Khaloti Rai
Piu Ro Ro Qabar Bananda Ay
Nai Samjah Aundi, Haye Keyway Babay Nay
Hay Rait Day Vich Rakheya Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ay Qabar E Nabi Chon Ai Sada
Sughra Hun Aas Muka Day Tu
Khaa Barchi Gai Haye Tere Akber Nu
Shabbir Ditta Dafna Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Maasoom Sakina Di Jholi
Shah Laash Asghar Di Rakhda Ay
Nai Aya Ay Haye Tera Ghazi
Na Bacheya Ay Tera Asghar
